values.quote: '''Corki''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Missile Barrage'' charge, up to a maximum of 4
He gains 2 charges upon learning the ability

values.meaning: Big One damage multiplier (dealing 100% increased damage, i.e. 2x)
values.quote: Every third missile '''Corki''' fires is a ''{{ai|Big One|Corki}}'', dealing 100% increased damage

values.meaning: basic attack on-hit recharge time reduction
values.quote: reduce ''Missile Barrage's'' remaining recharge time by {{pp|2 to 6 for 11|0 to 100|type=critical strike chance|color=critical chance|key1=%}} seconds
values.binNote: Bin formula (1 + 2xcritChance) * CDReductionOnHit=2 gives a flat 2s at 0% crit scaling linearly to 6s at 100% crit, matching the wiki's stated 2 to 6 seconds pp; recorded here as base 2 with a critChance term of coefficient 2 (i.e. 2 + 4*crit) rather than a by-level list since the underlying driver is crit chance, not champion level.

mechanics.claim: Missiles fire in the target direction and explode on the first enemy hit, dealing AoE damage.
mechanics.quote: fires a missile in the target direction that explodes upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within the area

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks on-hit against champions reduce the ability's recharge time, scaling with critical strike chance.
mechanics.quote: Basic attacks on-hit against champions reduce ''Missile Barrage's'' remaining recharge time by {{pp|2 to 6 for 11|0 to 100|type=critical strike chance|color=critical chance|key1=%}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Corki gains 2 charges upon learning the ability and the maximum of 4 upon respawning.
mechanics.quote: He gains 2 charges upon learning the ability and maximum charges upon [[death|respawning]].

mechanics.claim: Every third missile fired is a Big One, dealing 100% increased damage, with increased range and explosion radius.
mechanics.quote: Every third missile '''Corki''' fires is a ''{{ai|Big One|Corki}}'', dealing 100% increased damage as well as gaining increased range and explosion radius.

mechanics.claim: Corki retains progress toward a Big One when he dies.
mechanics.quote: '''Corki''' retains progress towards a ''Big One'' when he {{tip|fatal damage|dies}}.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cast time begins at the start of the cast, per the standard effect-at-cast-time-start note.
